[b][size=6]Installation [color=#cfe2f3]Guide[/color][/size][/b]

How to load Cute Pink Seasonal Garage & Tractor?
[b]Android users[/b]
1. Download the file "[b][color=#cfe2f3][CP] Cute Blue Seasonal Garage & Tractor[/color][/b]".
2. Must download [b][color=#d9ead3]Zarchiver[/color][/b] or any types of [b]Zip[/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3. Click Extract to get the files
4. Paste the Mod file into the Mods folder “[b][color=#fff2cc]Stardewvalley[/color][/b][b]”[/b].
5. Click your [b]SMAPI[/b] Installer and launch the app to load the CBSGT mod. Enjoy..
[b] [/b]
[b]Windows users[/b]
1. Download the file "[color=#f4cccc][b][color=#cfe2f3][CP] Cute Blue Seasonal Garage & Tractor[/color][/b][/color]".
2. Must download [b][color=#ea9999]Winrar[/color][/b] or any types of [b]Zip [/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3. Click Extract to get the files
4. Copy and paste the mod file into your “[b][color=#fff2cc]Stardew Valley[/color][/b][b]”[/b] folder.
5. Click your [b]SMAPI[/b] exe to load the CBSGT mod. Enjoy..

[b][size=5]The [color=#ff0000]Problems[/color] that you'll might encounter[/size][/b]
There are two versions of Cute Blue Seasonal Garage & Tractor, the [i]Content Patcher[/i] and [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i].
GMCM Version doesn’t load properly, Here’s the step. Firstly, You have to run
your SDV for it to load the assets (Play the game around 10 seconds). Lastly,
Exit the game title and you can now toggle on/off the assets of which you like.
So far, there are no bugs have found on the Content Patcher CBSGT version yet
but please let me know by joining my discord server.
